phase: Final production Build3; all targeted recaptures complete
rubricNotes: Native mobile keys intentionally collapse to the visible Key summary with object names, as specified in P1.2; opening meanings is keyboard accessible. Scores assess the six pedagogical criteria using screenshots and controls, not formal WCAG certification. Desktop 1440×1000/mobile 390×900; genuine WebGL2 via ANGLE SwiftShader and disabled WebGL.

tenFamilyScorecard.evidence: Native semantic key identifies observations, target, selected point and residual gaps. Existing scenario/observation/solver controls, computed train/test errors, onstage challenge and numeric SVG projection remain functional.

Population key and natural-frequency levers remain visible; the default starts with all 1,000 emails. A computed and skippable keyboard prediction precedes flagged-result reveal; context changes reset feedback, and dismissal persists.

Native key identifies original cube, transformed cube and selected corner. Rotation/shear/scale changes update actual matrix/determinant/corner displacement; both renderer label layouts are readable at 390px.
Visible A/B/sum readouts and six sliders update the head-to-tail diagram. Input/current/output roles are distinct and named; native equal-model projection, cancellation challenge and Reset work.

Direction cloud, original/output arrows and power path use computed matrix/residual values. Scale/shear/rotation modes and a skippable computed prediction remain unsolved initially. Actual direction-cloud fitting makes portrait markers readable; keyboard map/renderer fallback work.

Linked shared-floor 3D bars and projected fallback show both live sums and errors. Partition/refinement controls, semantic key and estimate/refinement challenge are visible; mobile projected captions fit.

Seeded batches, reveal/budget/play/restart/new-run controls tie inside counts to pi estimate and actual log-log error. Shape and color identify purple inside cubes versus blue outside spheres; native projection preserves3D membership, and the error plot is available without WebGL.

Starting point and rate presets lead to computed position/loss/norm/step readouts and a skippable next-step prediction. Step/replay/manual controls remain usable when motion is paused; bowl fits 390px and native projection preserves update mathematics.

Movable evaluation point and secant offset link actual curve/section, secant and tangent to derivative/secant/error values. Named key, challenge and keyboard-operable native controls/projection work on both renderers.

Both linked native charts fit stage dimensions. Start/end/partition controls update integral, area sum and error; the curve, signed area, accumulated function and endpoint tangent are named, with a sign/refinement challenge.

numericalChecks: All Monte Carlo budgets (100, 500, 2,000 and 10,000) reproduce identical same-seed estimates; Restart resets the revealed count to zero.
Native Decision Boundary point titles and mistake rings independently match the misclassified readouts for all eight dataset/boundary combinations.
Gaussian density heights stay finite at sigmaX=sigmaY=0.6, rho=0.9 (peak12.745); equal-density contour curves show the surface. Top view preserves the same sample statistics and membership.

Subspace zero/default/large input cases have finite values and zero reconstruction and orthogonality readouts. The final camera change exposes the row plane without changing coordinates or mathematics.

evidence.supplementalLogs: Full browser logs and individual screenshot PNGs retained in local /tmp/math-plan-* files.

limitations: Eight routes without WebGL provide guides, controls and a status notice without a graphical fallback; the plan target of at most ten is met.
Software GPU browser checks do not establish physical-device frame rates or formal WCAG conformance.
Family preview motifs are intentionally reused across related lessons; multiple SVG artworks exist per topic, rather than a unique image per lesson.
